purpose: Teach: 喜劇/白鳥/酒造/クジラ/雑学/落とし穴/飲み屋/平方メートル

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、喜劇のお笑い好きだろ?
lines.en: So you're into comedy sketches, right?
lines.style: Playful needle — testing him with something casual. Quick, knowing tone. Eyes bright with the beginning of a game.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、白鳥のバレエ観たろ?桜
lines.en: Have you seen Swan Lake? You know, that ballet?
lines.style: Turning it back on her immediately — sharp, almost defensive. Fast delivery to catch her mid-thought. Light challenge in his voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家、酒造業だろ?
lines.en: So your family's in the sake business, yeah?
lines.style: Pressing forward with the same rhythm. Casual on the surface but fishing for something. A half-smile in her voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、博物館でクジラの骨格見たろ?桜
lines.en: You've been to the museum and seen the whale skeleton, haven't you?
lines.style: Mirroring her rhythm exactly — he's caught the pattern. Steady, unapologetic. A small smile underneath the words.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、雑学クイズ大会出たろ?
lines.en: Wait, you entered that trivia competition, didn't you?
lines.style: Slight hesitation like she's checking her memory. Lighter tone — she knows she's being matched. Acknowledging he's keeping score too.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テストの落とし穴に注意しろよ、桜
lines.en: Watch out for the trick questions on the test, okay?
lines.style: Tone shifts — genuine concern breaks through the banter. Quieter, direct. Not quite a warning, more a look that says he cares.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のお父さん、近所の飲み屋常連だろ?
lines.en: Your dad hangs out at that bar near the station all the time, doesn't he?
lines.style: Back to poking, but a touch softer now. She's noticed something about him. Testing the boundary between teasing and stepping over.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会で平方メートルの計算やったろ?桜
lines.en: You covered square meters and area calculations in social studies, right?
lines.style: Quick recovery back to the game — he's anchoring each counter in something real. Close and warm, almost conspiratorial. Eyes on her the whole time.
